reason: The plugin is primarily a media-processing extension for DeepSeek Harness, focused on vision capabilities rather than general project tooling or orchestration. It exposes a runtime `vision` skill plus multiple image tools for analysis, OCR, grounding, detection, and color extraction, with path-based image input and web paste-to-path handling. Evidence from README and package metadata confirms external multimodal API usage, local image OCR fallback, and DSH plugin/client bundle integration, so classification is centered on media tools with moderate integration risk from optional external calls and file/image handling.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DeepSeek Harness 的视觉能力插件，提供图片识别、OCR、目标定位、目标枚举和主色分析等工具，并支持通过本地路径或粘贴图片进行图像识别。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness vision plugin that provides image analysis, OCR, grounding, detection, and color tools, with image input via local paths and paste-to-path image handling.

capabilities: Image and OCR analysis tools (general analysis, OCR, grounding, detection, color analysis, long-screenshot OCR)
Path-based image ingestion via local path, clipboard fallback, and paste-to-path workflow
Structured JSON outputs and result caching for repeated image analysis requests
Configurable failover among multiple multimodal providers with timeout and retry handling
Credential-based API key integration for external vision services
